title: Predictive Attack Pathing (Wat-Als)
goal: Enable hypothetical attack simulations by extending the graph algorithm to calculate paths from a mocked starting point (e.g. 'Assume CEO laptop is compromised').
scope: Graph traversal logic, hypothetical edges, and a 'Simulation Mode' in the Surface Map UI.
generation_reason: Moving from reactive assessment to predictive threat modeling.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Simulations are read-only. Do not dispatch live runners based on hypothetical paths.

success_criteria: Operator can drop a 'Starting Point' node in UI.
Backend calculates probable paths to critical assets.
UI visualizes these hypothetical paths distinctly from proven paths.

acceptance_criteria: Graph successfully computes paths without persisting them as factual evidence.
